<thought>Based on the most intense peak (m/z 224.1201) likely representing [M+H]+, the neutral monoisotopic mass is ≈223.1128 Da. The isotopic pattern (≈17.5 % M+1) suggests ~16 carbons. A formula that matches the exact mass is C₁₆H₁₅O (monoisotopic mass 223.1123 Da), which fits both the mass and the isotopic distribution.</thought>
<final_answer>C16H15O</final_answer>
